svg.text: Indonesia Administrative Boundaries — Resolution Tier Comparison

Official (0°) reference outline behind High-Detail & Simplified

2. Small-Island Coastline (900 × 585 m) — Pulau Panggang, Administrasi Kepulauan Seribu
